title: product-image list reply
description: PROPOSAL product-images §4.3: 200 reply of GET /api/v1/sync/product-images. The till pictures the portal holds for the calling business, in productId order (keyset paging). A product missing from the whole list has no picture on the portal. New members may be added.

imageHash.description: SHA-256 of the bytes the till sent for the picture held. Equal to the till's own → nothing to upload.

nextAfter.description: The after of the next page; null on the last page.
